description: This file defines a React component for customizing a toolbar in the Notesnook application, including drag-and-drop reordering, preset management, and group/subgroup handling.

methods.name: TreeNodeComponent
methods.description: Renders individual toolbar items or groups with drag-and-drop and remove/add controls.

methods.name: SortableWrapper
methods.description: Wraps toolbar items to make them sortable via drag-and-drop, handling visual states and actions.

methods.name: flatten
methods.description: Converts nested toolbar group definitions into a flat array of TreeNode objects with depth info.

methods.name: unflatten
methods.description: Converts a flat array of TreeNode objects back into nested toolbar group definitions.

methods.name: createGroup
methods.description: Creates a new group node with default or specified properties.

methods.name: createItem
methods.description: Creates a new item node with specified toolId and properties.

methods.name: createTrash
methods.description: Creates a special trash group node for disabled tools.

methods.name: moveGroup
methods.description: Moves a group node within the TreeNode array, respecting hierarchy rules.

methods.name: canMoveGroup
methods.description: Checks if a group can be moved to a target position based on hierarchy constraints.

methods.name: moveItem
methods.description: Moves an item node within the TreeNode array, adjusting depth and hierarchy.

methods.name: removeGroup
methods.description: Removes a group node and moves its items to the trash group.

methods.name: removeItem
methods.description: Removes an item node and moves it to the trash group.

methods.name: isCollapsed
methods.description: Determines if a node should be collapsed based on active selection.

methods.name: isSubgroup
methods.description: Type guard to check if a node is a subgroup.

methods.name: isGroup
methods.description: Type guard to check if a node is a group.

methods.name: isItem
methods.description: Type guard to check if a node is an item.

methods.name: isTrash
methods.description: Checks if a node is the trash node.

methods.name: isDeleted
methods.description: Checks if an item is in the trash group.

methods.name: getItemGroup
methods.description: Finds the group or subgroup that an item belongs to.

methods.name: getGroup
methods.description: Finds a group or subgroup node by ID, including its children.

methods.name: addSubGroup
methods.description: Adds a new subgroup under a specified group.

methods.name: addGroup
methods.description: Adds a new top-level group, optionally before the trash node.

methods.name: getDisabledTools
methods.description: Returns a list of tools that are currently disabled (not in the toolbar).
